listing.name: Amped 3 — Amped 3 Revamped (minty-hippo)
listing.summary: The project reports extensive testing of Northstar and Snowbird. Other areas and high-refresh-rate modes remain incomplete. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Amped 3 Xbox 360 disc ISO. USA Redump/XGD2 ISO.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s setup instructions with your own USA Amped 3 Redump/XGD2 ISO. Setup downloads source code and build tools, then builds the game locally.

warnings: The project reports extensive testing of Northstar and Snowbird. Other areas and high-refresh-rate modes remain incomplete.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
